source_text: Primitias omnium frugum omniumque pecorum sacerdotibus lex iubet offerri. Quod sacerdotibus datur, Deo offertur. Nemo licite fructibus utatur nisi prius Deo primitiae deferantur.
pass_a_gloss: Firstfruits of-all crops and-of-all cattle to-priests law orders to-be-offered. What to-priests is-given, to-God is-offered. No-one licitly fruits may-use unless first to-God firstfruits are-brought.
pass_b_english: The law orders [[firstfruits of all crops and flocks to be brought to the priests >> Bible:Numbers 18:8-19]]. What is given to priests is offered to God. No one may lawfully use the fruits until firstfruits are brought.
